title: C & F Financial Corp 8-K Filing — 2026-04-23
summary: C&F Financial Corporation filed a Form 8-K reporting the results of its April 21, 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders. All five Class III director nominees were elected, the advisory executive compensation vote passed, and the appointment of Yount, Hyde & Barbour, P.C. as independent auditor was ratified. This is a routine corporate governance filing with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: C&F Financial Corporation held its Annual Meeting of Shareholders on April 21, 2026, with a quorum of 2,687,415 shares present
Five Class III directors were elected to serve until the 2029 Annual Meeting, with approval votes ranging from approximately 2,008,497 to 2,045,224 shares
Advisory vote on named executive officer compensation was approved with 2,044,164 votes for, 14,692 against, and 10,891 abstentions
Appointment of Yount, Hyde & Barbour, P.C. as independent registered public accountant for fiscal year 2026 was ratified with 2,641,796 votes for
The filing is signed by Jason E. Long, Chief Financial Officer and Secretary, dated April 23, 2026
